Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Attached is the section of our RFI that focuses on control mapping for platform providers (SIG v2024 + ISO/ SOC crosswalk). We need a short control-to-evidence mapping and an initial sprint plan for evidence delivery so our procurement and security teams can evaluate RFP responses this quarter.

High-level asks: 
- Completed control map (SIG/ISO/SOC mapping) in the attached workbook (tab: redwood->kestrel)
- Copies of recent assurance artifacts: SOC 2 Type II report (2027), ISO 27001 cert and latest internal audit summary, pen test summary (redacted), KMS key rotation proof, and a brief architecture diagram that highlights customer data flows and VPC boundaries.
- A 5-business-day timeline for prioritized evidence and a MAP showing owners and handoff dates.

Deliverables needed by EOD Friday, Apr 14: completed workbook (Kestrel_RFI_v3.xlsx) and links to hosted evidence or a temporary shared drive. If you have any items that require NDAs or redaction, flag them up front.

We generally expect an initial intake/clarity call before delivery; is your team available Wed 4/12 10am PT?

Thanks,
Emma Li

Assigning owners and flagging items that need legal / infosec sign-off. Quick checklist based on Kestrel's asks:

2) SOC 2 Type II (2027) summary + assertion letter: redwood-soc2-summary-2027.pdf (attached); full report requires an NDA — recommend we upload summary now and request NDA for the full report. (owner: Kimberly)
3) ISO 27001 certificate + audit summary: need to confirm current audit dates; I will include cert image and high-level scope. (owner: Kimberly)
4) Pen test summary (third-party) — redacted exec summary ok; full details require procurement/legal approval. (owner: Kimberly)
5) KMS key rotation logs / proof of keys in HSM: redaction/TEK required; I will prepare a sanitized rotation ledger extract. (owner: Kimberly – request from infra)
6) Architecture diagram & telemetry sample: Jordan to produce redwood-arch-diagram-vpc.pdf and a short note describing runtime telemetry (latency, KV cache hits, KMS calls per 100k tokens) instead of raw logs. (owner: Jordan)
7) MAP and Drive share: Neha to create folder and populate with the spreadsheet, summary PDFs, and a delivery MAP. She should also draft a short cover email for Emma and Samir. (owner: Neha)

Timeline: we can deliver the completed workbook tab and the three summary PDFs by EOD Thu 4/13. For any items that require NDAs (full SOC2, pen test), we will request Kestrel sign the attached short NDA (one-page) and DocuSign link will be provided.
